script.text: Scientists dated this shark to three hundred and ninety two years old. It is a Greenland shark. And that number came from its eye. The lens never changes after birth. So they radiocarbon dated it. But here is the part nobody repeats. The real range was two hundred and seventy two, to five hundred and twelve. We do not know how old it is, within two hundred and forty years. It grows less than a centimetre a year, and swims slower than you walk. And nearly all of them are going blind. A parasite clamps onto the eye, and feeds on it. It will keep going for another century. Blind, in the cold, two thousand metres down.
